name: Account login not accepting credentials
description: Users unable to log into their accounts with correct passwords.

name: Basic features locked behind Premium paywall
description: Core functionality like song selection and playback restricted to Premium subscribers.

name: Lyrics missing or not displaying
description: Lyrics unavailable for some songs in the catalog.

name: Limited music catalog selection
description: Certain music genres and songs absent from the platform.

name: Poor playlist and recommendation quality
description: Playlists play random songs and recommendations have declined in quality.

name: Downloads stuck in progress
description: Downloaded songs remain stuck in background download process.

name: Offline mode not functioning
description: Offline playback feature not working properly.

name: General app dissatisfaction
description: Users express overall disappointment with the app and recent updates.

name: WiFi connection issues
description: App unable to connect to internet over WiFi.

name: App crashes or fails to load
description: App crashes or gets stuck on loading screen after recent updates.

name: Music stops or pauses unexpectedly
description: Playback stops mid-song or music adjustment features malfunction.

name: Poor customer support experience
description: Customer support team perceived as rude and unhelpful.

name: Excessive and intrusive ads
description: Too many ads play frequently, interrupting music listening experience.

name: Autoplay cannot be disabled
description: Automatic audio playback lacks clear settings option to disable.

name: Limited skip and rewind controls
description: Users unable to skip enough songs or rewind during playback.

name: New home screen update poor design
description: Recent home screen redesign negatively received by users.
